questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: The cable stays AB and AD help support pole AC. Knowing that the tension is 120 lb in AB and 40 lb in AD, determine the magnitude and direction of the resultant of the forces exerted by the stays at A.
choices: $139.1\text{ lb}$ at $67.0^\circ$ down and to the left
$112.5\text{ lb}$ at $35.7^\circ$ down and to the left
$139.1\text{ lb}$ at $23.0^\circ$ down and to the left
$126.5\text{ lb}$ at $67.0^\circ$ down and to the left

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If $P = 75\text{ N}$ and $Q = 125\text{ N}$, determine the magnitude of the resultant force at point A.
questions.situation_text: Two forces P and Q are applied at point A of a hook support. Force P is directed $20^\circ$ to the left of the downward vertical, and force Q is directed $35^\circ$ to the right of the downward vertical.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: For the same loading condition ($P = 75\text{ N}$ and $Q = 125\text{ N}$), determine the direction of the resultant force measured from the horizontal.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: f the loads are changed to $P = 60\text{ lb}$ and $Q = 25\text{ lb}$, determine the magnitude and direction of the resultant force at point A.
choices: $77.6\text{ lb}$ at $85.0^\circ$ down and to the left
$77.6\text{ lb}$ at $5.0^\circ$ down and to the left
$50.8\text{ lb}$ at $85.0^\circ$ down and to the left
$77.6\text{ lb}$ at $85.0^\circ$ down and to the right

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: Knowing that $\alpha = 25^\circ$, determine the magnitude of the force P so that the resultant force exerted on the trolley is vertical.
questions.situation_text: A trolley that moves along a horizontal beam is acted upon by two forces at point $A$: a $1600\text{ N}$ force directed $15^\circ$ below the horizontal to the left, and a force P directed at an angle $\alpha$ to the right of the downward vertical.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: For the same condition where $\alpha = 25^\circ$ and the resultant force is vertical, what is the corresponding magnitude of the resultant?

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If the angle $\alpha$ is not fixed, determine the magnitude and direction $\alpha$ of the force P so that the resultant is a vertical force of $2500\text{ N}$.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: Knowing that $\alpha = 20^\circ$, determine the required magnitude of the force P if the resultant R of the two forces applied at $A$ is to be vertical.
questions.situation_text: A steel tank is to be positioned in an excavation by two forces applied at point A: a $425\text{ lb}$ force directed $30^\circ$ above the horizontal to the left, and a force P directed at an angle $\alpha$ above the horizontal to the right

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: For the same condition where $\alpha = 20^\circ$ and the resultant R is vertical, determine the corresponding magnitude of R.

questions.subject: PSAD
questions.question: If the magnitude of P is instead set to $500\text{ lb}$, determine the required angle $\alpha$ so that the resultant R is vertical, along with the corresponding magnitude of R.
